manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Changeling Hero must be exiled by Lagrella, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Lagrella until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
